label: REAL
note: Snapshot of planned and current Caltrans lane closures on the highways the SIMULATED segments follow. Reference only: not a live feed, and not used in any calculation. Times are Pacific local time. Most rows are planned roadwork; this is not a record of crashes or emergency closures.
matching: A closure belongs to a segment when it is on the same highway and direction and starts within 3 km of the segment's drawn line. Segment lines are schematic, so this is approximate. Only mainline, connector and HOV closures are stored; ramp closures are counted in counts.ramp_closures_left_out. A closure no longer in the feed keeps the status it had when last seen.
